title: Module pullback transports scalar multiplication
statement: Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal E$ be small sites, $L$ a finite-limit-preserving functor of their topoi and $F$ its algebraic inverse-image datum [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]. Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $a\in A$ and $M$ a sheaf of $\underline A$-modules on $\mathcal C$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with constants as in [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Let $\beta_a$ be the transported global section of [lem-sp-constant-inverse-image-section], including the structural map to the target constant coefficient sheaf. The prescribed ordinary module pullback $P=\mathrm{pull}(F,\mathrm{constantMap}(F,A))$ satisfies $P(a\cdot\mathrm{id}_M)=\beta_a\cdot\mathrm{id}_{P(M)}$.

source.place: Tags 03D2 and 03D7; sites.tex Tag 00YV; sites-cohomology.tex Tag 093M

proof.text: Use inverseImageSection_map from [lem-sp-constant-inverse-image-section] to identify the transported scalar on any test sheaf. Apply moduleSMul on the underlying sheaf of M to the scalar map, identity and multiplication map. Naturality of moduleUnderlying proves that algebraic module inverse image carries multiplication by a to multiplication by its transported global section.

Apply the injective Hom equivalence of the scalar-extension adjunction of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-module-adjunction] to the two endomorphisms. Unit naturality and linearity identify extension of the transported scalar with multiplication by its structural image beta_a.

proof_origin.place: Transport of module operations, Tags 03D2/03D7; canonical inverse image of constants, Sites Tag 00YV.

lean.statement:
theorem constantPullback_scalar
    {C E : Type u} [SmallCategory C] [SmallCategory E]
    {JC : GrothendieckTopology C} {JD : GrothendieckTopology E}
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    {L : Sheaf JC (Type u) ⥤ Sheaf JD (Type u)}
    [PreservesFiniteLimits L] (F : InverseImageData L)
    (a : A) (M : Mod (constant JC A)) :
    (pull F (constantMap F A)).map
        ⟨PresheafOfModules.sectionsSMul M.val (constantSection (J := JC) a)⟩ =
      ⟨PresheafOfModules.sectionsSMul
        ((pull F (constantMap F A)).obj M).val (transportedConstantSection F A a)⟩
